name: Dots joined by dashes
what: Three dots of different sizes turn together on a dark page while dashed lines are drawn between them into a triangle; the figure grows a little, the dots change colour and a name pops in beside each dot.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f78 the dots turn together about the middle (about 160 degrees, slow start, long soft finish); f7-f18 and f19-f30 the first two dashed lines are drawn, f31-f75 the closing line slowly; f78-f93 the figure grows 21 %; f97-f110 the dots change from white to the highlight colour; f92, f96 and f100 the names pop in one by one (a quick growth that settles over about 20 f); then it holds to the end
